correctness.rationale: The hemisphere separation density (1-theta/pi)sin theta integrates to 1 and gives exact moments 4/pi and 2. Funk-Hecke and Legendre orthogonality yield the exact common-vertex covariance with coefficients b_k=(pi/8)(4k+3)c_k^2/(k+1)^2 and q_k=(-1)^k c_k/(2(k+1)); their multiplication is pi^2/256 times the stated sixth-power series. The symmetric cycle has exactly n adjacent unordered edge pairs for all n>=3 and all other distinct pairs are independent; thus variance is n(v+2 gamma). Bounded stationary one-dependence yields the CLT. Every step was independently algebraically reconstructed; the numerical test checks 420000 sampled cases and a deterministic series remainder less than pi^2/(448*32^7) for covariance.

value.rationale: For the first nontrivial uniform hemisphere random convex-hull spherical polytope (three points), the exact perimeter variance is a natural intrinsic geometric invariant absent from the directly inspected first-moment theory. The positive shared-vertex covariance quantitatively measures boundary-induced edge dependence; the same constant controls the full family of labelled cycle perimeters and its nondegenerate Gaussian limit. The central-binomial sixth-power series and certified O(N^-7) truncation give precise stable evaluation. This is a substantial structured second-order statistic rather than a routine first-moment formula or arbitrary finite slice.
